nehemiah.3.p1.b1.text: At the Sheep Gate, Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests began rebuilding. They dedicated it and installed its doors. …

nehemiah.3.p1.b2.text: The Fish Gate was rebuilt by the sons of Hassenaah. They laid its beams and installed its doors, bolts, and bars.

nehemiah.3.p1.b3.text: Next to him, the Tekoites made repairs, but their nobles did not put their shoulders to the work under their supervisors.

nehemiah.3.p2.b1.text: Next to them, repairs were made by Melatiah the Gibeonite … the men of Gibeon and Mizpah, who were under the authority of the governor of the region west of the Euphrates.

nehemiah.3.p2.b2.text: Next to them, Uzziel son of Harhaiah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs, and next to him, Hananiah son of the perfumer made repairs.

nehemiah.3.p2.b3.text: next to him, Jedaiah son of Harumaph made repairs across from his house

nehemiah.3.p2.b4.text: And next to them, Shallum son of Hallohesh, ruler of the other half-district of Jerusalem, made repairs, with the help of his daughters.

nehemiah.3.p3.b1.text: The Valley Gate was repaired by Hanun and the residents of Zanoah. … repaired a thousand cubits of the wall as far as the Dung Gate.

nehemiah.3.p3.b2.text: The Dung Gate was repaired by Malchijah son of Rechab, ruler of the district of Beth-haccherem. …

nehemiah.3.p3.b3.text: … He also repaired the wall of the Pool of Shelah near the king’s garden, as far as the stairs that descend from the City of David.

nehemiah.3.p3.b4.text: Next to him, the Levites made repairs under Rehum son of Bani

nehemiah.3.p4.b1.text: Next to him, Baruch son of Zabbai diligently repaired another section, from the angle to the doorway of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

nehemiah.3.p4.b2.text: Next to him, Meremoth son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, repaired another section, from the doorway of the house of Eliashib to the end of the house.

nehemiah.3.p4.b3.text: Beyond them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs in front of their house

nehemiah.3.p4.b4.text: And next to them, the Tekoites repaired another section, from a point opposite the great tower that juts out to the wall of Ophel.

nehemiah.3.p5.b1.text: Above the Horse Gate, each of the priests made repairs in front of his own house.

nehemiah.3.p5.b2.text: And between the upper room above the corner and the Sheep Gate, the goldsmiths and merchants made repairs.
